metadata.title: That 1 kill Valorant gave me like ‘Wait, how did YOU get that?!’
metadata.description:
Aim was on pause but somehow got a kill.
Enemy probably uninstalling to rethink life choices.
Valorant logic: ‘No clue, but here’s a freebie.’

Click if your aim ghosts but the kills don’t!
